title: Post-0.15.1 follow-ups from the #756 round-2 verdict: lore query equalsFold, stale reconcile-shared comments, coverage gap, rename in the CHANGELOG
description:
From the #756 round-2 APPROVE (verdict recorded on LCLI-809); out of scope for 0.15.1 by leader ruling.
- src/core/query.ts ~:394 equalsFold, the generic lore query key=value filter, still folds with toLowerCase; align it with referenceKey or state why it stays.
- Stale comments in src/commands/reconcile-shared.ts ~:196 and ~:310 still describe lowercase keying.
- Coverage gap: reconcile-shared.ts ~:271 (the non-ASCII path in resolveRollupDetails) has no test with a non-ASCII id through the rollup resolver.
- The CHANGELOG fold entry names check, sync, link, unlink, tasks, orphans and the projection but not rename (which dedupes through the same referenceKey); name it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: equalsFold is aligned or its divergence is documented, with a test
The stale reconcile-shared comments are corrected and a non-ASCII rollup-resolver test exists
The CHANGELOG fold entry names rename
